hosted.method: Independent AI-assisted adjudication against unchanged mandatory criteria and fatal-error list, with answer-line evidence. Exact identifiers must remain unambiguous across an actionable answer.
findings: U 4/4 and E 4/4: no accepted-quality improvement established by E versus U in this packet.
Eplus 3/4 under strict exact-identifier criterion: no additional learned Alpha established.
Calls U 7 / E 6 / Eplus 8 are self-reported resource counts, not complete costs or causal efficiency estimates.
All answers meet the common 1,600-word ceiling; all self-report at most 8 tools.
One trial per arm on four correlated historical-source jobs cannot establish population superiority or method-caused harm.
hosted.criterion_H4_3_application: The enhanced answer states the correct full serial once but later uses the component ID as a serial in its requested next action. Strict complete acceptance requires resolving that conflict; it was not corrected.
hosted.nonprimary_lenient_reading: If the correct table entry alone were sufficient and the conflicting action ignored, Eplus would be 4/4. That is not the exact-identifier acceptance applied here; either reading establishes no additional accepted-quality gain.

admission.reason: Prospective finite-horizon expected benefit must exceed all additional costs; no future-demand oracle.
admission.limitation: Assumed distributions and small development sample; not empirical market evidence. Benefit omits adverse opening-cash friction, so rejection is not repaired by adding it.
